caribbean.headline: Grand Cayman Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: Grand Cayman is experiencing 12 kt winds and 4.9 ft waves, with 88% rain probability. St. Maarten will see 18 kt winds, while swell remains moderate.
